newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices gain on world trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices gain on world trends.

text.p: Indian copper prices on Friday saw gains on global trends, dealers said.
Other base metals remained steady in a narrow prices band.
"Copper moved up by 50 rupees at 13,850 rupees per quintal amid limited supplies while rising global prices prompted buying interest," a broker said. Copper rose by 50 rupees on Thursday.
Nickel prices fell by 100 rupees at 36,200 rupees per quintal as losses in the world market triggered profit-taking.

Tin was quiet at 30,900 rupees per quintal. So was zinc at 8,050 rupees and lead at 4,100 rupees per quintal on restricted activity. Aluminium was indicated at the previous level of 7,700 rupees but trading was nominal.
